<div style="margin:0 5px">Events are a mini-game accessible every 2 months, lasting for a month each. Events exist entirely within their own menu; they are not affected by anything you do outside of them, nor do they affect main-game functionality. They do, however, offer Event Upgrades for {{Sprites|Gem||16x16}}, grant main-game rewards like {{Sprites|Skill Bit||16x16}} and {{Sprites|Relic Chest|Chests#Relic Chests|16x16}}, and sell various goodies like {{Sprites|Gift||16x16}}, also for {{Sprites|Gem||16x16}}.</div></div>
{{Clear|left}}

==In-game description==
<div style="margin:auto;font-size:0.9em">
{{Quote
|quote = 
Events run every other month and can be played passively along with your progression in the main game.

Defeat a wave of enemies to earn currencies, use that currency to upgrade your miner. Reach higher waves to unlock rewards!

Event currency income:<br>
Every wave you will earn: {{CurrentEventImage|field=currency1}}<br>
Every 5th wave you will earn: {{CurrentEventImage|field=currency2}}<br>
Every 10th wave you will earn: {{CurrentEventImage|field=currency3}}<br>
Every 15th wave you will earn: {{CurrentEventImage|field=currency4}}<br>

Currency gain scales as you reach deeper waves, for example on wave 10 you will get 10 {{CurrentEventImage|field=currency1}}, 2 {{CurrentEventImage|field=currency2}} and 1 {{CurrentEventImage|field=currency3}}.

The rewards to look out for are the event skins that swag out your miner and give you access to new stats, lootbug skins, inventory/bomb bag skins and mythic relic chests! {{CurrentEventImage|field=skinIcon}} [[File:Mythic Chest.png|20x20px]]
}}</div>

==Strategy==
{{See also|Guides/Events_Guide}}
This strategy summary may spoil fun of event playthrough, so read this only if you wish to have a step-by-step guide to efficiently accessing all rewards.

===Spending Gems===
Beating the event for the minimum amount of gems:
* Spend {{gems|1225}} immediately: 1x ''125% event speed'', 1x ''2x currency'', and 3x ''+10% health''.
* If you don't have {{gems|1225}} ready, prioritize 2x currency for {{gems|500}}.
* Follow guidance on optimal prestiging below.
* As long as you check in regularly, you should beat the event near its end.
* Guaranteed {{gems|655}} and 72 [[Store#Skill_Bits|skill bits]] (double if you build [[construct#Monuments|W2 monument]] before claiming), plus more from [[store#gifts|gifts]] = worth the gems.
If you value speed over gems, buy 2 more (+10% health) and optionally 2 of the gem (+10% attack damage) to beat with ~10 days remaining.

===Other tips===
* The upgrades page is scrollable!!!
*  Early on focus attack damage upgrades to one shot enemies
*  Very quickly attack damage upgrades become obsolete. At that point focus on HP and attack speed
*  Attack speed is very important, in essence it is an extension of HP
* For 2x rewards you only have to build the [[construct#Monuments|W2 monument]] before actually claiming the rewards, so don't claim them right away and try to build the monument before the end of the month.

===Optimal prestiging===
These are the Prestige Ranks worth prestiging for once reached, unless you are extremely close to the next rank due to coming back from a long idle. You can claim 1 Prestige Rank (P) for every 5 waves completed, starting at wave (W) 10.

P1/W10 -> P2/W15 -> P5/W30 -> P10/W55 -> P20/W105 -> P40/W205

This should be enough to reach wave 250.

== Event Upgrades ==
{{See also|Events/Costs}}
All '''non-gem''' Upgrades (Tier 1–4 / currency Upgrades) use the same exponential cost formula: each level costs '''25% more''' than the previous level. The cost of level <math>L</math> (1-based) is <math>\text{round}(\text{base} \times 1.25^{L-1})</math>, where ''base'' is the level-1 price listed in the upgrade table. Gem Upgrades use separate fixed or linear gem pricing (see below), not this formula.
